adjudication.rationale: In `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed`, it parses the entire feed (`SimpleRSS.parse open(...)`) and then iterates `rss.items.each` with no limit/cap. For each item it calls `TopicEmbed.import(...)`, which performs a per-item DB lookup (`TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first`) and additional per-item work (SHA1 of full contents and `Nokogiri::HTML.fragment` via `absolutize_urls`). This is a concrete perf/scalability concern introduced by the diff, but not a correctness/security defect by itself.
